task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use the left arm to grab the red green beverage can, put it into the medium yellow basket with slots, and lift the medium yellow basket with slots with another arm.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架，用左臂抓住红绿色饮料罐，将其放入中黄带槽篮中，用另一臂提起中黄带槽篮。
